data.name: 設定 LINE 官方帳號，將監控通知傳送至已確認的 LINE 群組。
data.value: Configure a LINE Official Account to send monitoring notifications to approved LINE groups.

data.name: 憑證已設定後不會再次顯示。留空可保留目前的值。
data.value: Credentials are not shown again after saving. Leave fields blank to keep current values.

data.name: 異常通知彙整等待時間（0～300 秒）
LINE 必須能連線至此 HTTPS 網址；本機 localhost 網址無法直接接收 LINE 事件。
data.value: LINE must be able to reach this HTTPS URL; a local localhost URL cannot receive LINE events directly.

data.name: 啟用官方帳號加入群組與 webhook，並設定上方 Webhook URL。
data.value: , enable group joining and webhooks for the Official Account, then set the Webhook URL above.

data.name: 一次邀請官方帳號加入一個 LINE 群組。
data.value: Invite the Official Account to one LINE group at a time.

data.name: 重新整理此頁，為最新的候選群組命名並確認啟用。
data.value: Refresh this page, name the latest candidate group and confirm activation.

data.name: LINE 群組與 Vigiloom 的設備群組彼此獨立；聊天訊息不會自動啟用通知。
data.value: LINE groups are separate from Vigiloom device groups; chat messages do not automatically enable notifications.

data.name: 僅已確認的群組會收到監控通知。
data.value: Only confirmed groups receive monitoring notifications.

data.name: 尚未收到群組資訊。邀請官方帳號加入群組後，重新整理此頁。
data.value: No group information received. Invite the Official Account to a group, then refresh this page.

data.name: 顯示最近 20 筆；LINE 已受理不代表訊息已送達。
data.value: Showing the latest 20; acceptance by LINE does not mean the message was delivered.

data.name: 目前無法載入設定，請稍後再試。
data.value: Unable to load settings. Try again later.

data.name: 登入已失效，請重新登入。
data.value: Your session expired. Sign in again.

data.name: 請先設定 Channel access token 與 Channel secret，再啟用通知。
data.value: Configure the channel access token and channel secret before enabling notifications.

data.name: 無法儲存設定，請稍後再試。
data.value: Unable to save settings. Try again later.

data.name: LINE 已受理測試通知。請至群組確認是否收到。
data.value: LINE accepted the test notification. Check the group to confirm receipt.

data.value: The test notification did not complete. Check credentials, group settings and background jobs, then retry.

data.value: Unable to confirm the test notification status.
